response.overview: A documentary set in Melaka, follows the daily life of an old couple who runs their own bak chang business. They wake up at dawn everyday just to prepare the ingredients, cook all the filling, and wrap the chang. As age is catching up on them, the business is slowly coming to an end. Even with no one to take over their business, they continue living their happy life.
response.tagline: An elderly couple spends each day running their small business together, continuing the traditional craft of bak chang
response.title: 粽 (Chang)
